title: Injectivity of literal polarity flipping
statement: Fix $n \in \bbn$, and recall that a literal is a pair consisting of a variable in $\{0, 1, \dots, n-1\}$ together with a polarity bit, and that flipping a literal's polarity toggles this bit while leaving the variable unchanged. Then the polarity-flipping operation is injective: if two literals have the same polarity flip, they are equal.
